submitted.rationale: All five EQE measurements (Sb fractions 0.117, 0.308, 0.447, 0.594, 0.682) were at the noise floor (|EQE| < 0.005%). This fits La–Sb oxides, which have wide band gaps and absorb little at 2.7 eV. Index 4 (Sb 0.117) had the only positive value (0.00023%), so it is the nominal best. The difference is within noise.
